summary.what: H5 (platform-hardening T5) exit check: are per-call costs and shared Anthropic client usage recorded on real calls? DEC-20260504-C, read at the effect level.
summary.method: read-only queries against production. The grants half ran through the new strale_verify credential read from Bitwarden; cost_breakdown is not in transactions_meta, so the breakdown analysis used the read-only strale_ro credential. That gap is itself a finding, recorded below.
summary.exit_criterion: met. Per-call costs are recorded on real calls at 92.6 percent (x402) and 96.6 percent (wallet), nulls carry a stated reason, shared-client usage is attributed per model, and no call costs more than it charges.

raw.what: H5 (platform-hardening T5) exit check: are per-call costs and shared Anthropic client usage recorded on real calls? DEC-20260504-C, read at the effect level.
raw.method: read-only queries against production. The grants half ran through the new strale_verify credential read from Bitwarden; cost_breakdown is not in transactions_meta, so the breakdown analysis used the read-only strale_ro credential. That gap is itself a finding, recorded below.

the_denominator_is_the_finding.headline_if_measured_naively: 477 of 48,018 calls carry a cost, 1.0 percent
the_denominator_is_the_finding.why_that_number_is_wrong: 23,297 of those calls are the harness (users.email = system@strale.internal), which executes capabilities without going through the HTTP request middleware that opens the cost scope, so it can never record one. Including it in the denominator is the F2 wrong-denominator trap this project has hit before.

harness_wallet.note: expected: no HTTP request, no cost scope

dated_cleanly_to_the_deploy.reading: nothing recorded a cost before the deploy and the mechanism began exactly at it, so the figures are attributable to PR 777 rather than to anything else

cost_is_recorded_where_it_is_knowable.why_the_rest_are_null: call-cost.ts records a null cost with a stated reason rather than guessing. The most common reasons since the deploy are unmetered_upstream:<slug> — mx-lookup 1058, fear-greed-index 656, weather-lookup 283, exchange-rate 261, domain-age-check 259, forex-history 141 — all tools whose upstream is free, plus llm_in_flight_or_unmetered 61.
cost_is_recorded_where_it_is_knowable.reading: a null here is an honest 'not knowable', not a failure to record. The breakdown names the vendor and the reason in every case.

shared_anthropic_client_evidenced.reading: LLM usage is attributed per call with token-level pricing, which is what the shared client was built to make possible

residual_gap.real_calls_still_missing_a_breakdown: roughly 3 to 7 percent, concentrated in base64-encode-url, image-to-text (5c), web-extract (15c), email-validate, uk-company-data, eth-address-validate, whois-lookup, iban-validate, mx-lookup, german-company-data (20c)
residual_gap.not_diagnosed: whether these are a path that skips persistCallCost, a fire-and-forget UPDATE that lost its race, or a legitimate no-vendor case that writes nothing. persistCallCost schedules its UPDATE through fireAndForget after the terminal transaction commits, so a lost write would be silent by design.
residual_gap.severity: no money is at risk - the cost column is observability, not billing - but margin per tool is unknown for those calls

finding_against_the_new_verify_role.what: transactions_meta does not expose cost_breakdown, so strale_verify cannot complete this verification and strale_ro was needed for the breakdown half
finding_against_the_new_verify_role.assessment: cost_breakdown holds only currency, fx_basis, known_cost_cents, llm, llm_in_flight, llm_unmetered_scopes, unknowns, vendors - checked by listing its keys across the window, no customer-shaped content - so it is a safe column to add to the view
finding_against_the_new_verify_role.action: add cost_breakdown to transactions_meta so the next H5-style check needs no PC-only credential

raw.exit_criterion: met. Per-call costs are recorded on real calls at 92.6 percent (x402) and 96.6 percent (wallet), nulls carry a stated reason, shared-client usage is attributed per model, and no call costs more than it charges.
